description_en: Submits a live stream snapshot job. If the job is submitted during stream ingest, it automatically starts in asynchronous mode. Otherwise, it does not start
description_zh: 调用SubmitLiveSnapshotJob提交实时截图任务。如果在推流中提交，则会自动异步启动任务，否则为未启动状态
kebab_example: aliyun ice submit-live-snapshot-job --job-name Screenshot_task1 --stream-input Type=rtmp Url=rtmp://www.aliyun.com/stream --snapshot-output StorageType=oss Endpoint=oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com Bucket=testbucket --template-id 0000a046-263c-3560-978a-fb2877820000 --callback-url http://www.aliyun.com/snapshot/callback --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitLiveSnapshotJob

parameters.help_en:
The name of the job.

It cannot exceed 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
任务名称。
最大长度为128
parameters.name: job_name

fields.help_en:
The URL of the input stream.

It cannot exceed 255 characters in length
fields.help_zh:
流输入地址。
最大长度为255
fields.name: url

fields.help_en: The type of the input stream. The value can only be rtmp
fields.help_zh: 流输入类型。目前只支持rtmp
fields.name: type

parameters.help_en: The information about the input stream
parameters.name: stream_input

fields.help_en: The storage type of the snapshot. The value can only be oss
fields.help_zh: 截图存储类型。目前只支持oss
fields.name: storage_type

fields.help_en: The output endpoint of the snapshot
fields.name: endpoint

fields.help_en: The bucket of the snapshot output endpoint
fields.name: bucket

parameters.help_en: The information about the output snapshot
parameters.name: snapshot_output

parameters.help_en:
The snapshot callback URL.

It cannot exceed 255 characters in length.

Both HTTP and HTTPS URLs are supported
parameters.help_zh:
截图回调地址。
最大长度为255。
支持http/https
parameters.name: callback_url
